description: Bulk label + 30d summary lookup for many addresses in one call. Caps at 100 addresses. Returns one row per input address in input order, with: entity, wallet_type, risk_flag, 30d net flow, 30d volume, 30d tx count, read from `chain`'s own tables. The 30d fields are live and null only for an address with no label (found: false). A row whose address source provider_e knows also carries provider_e: a list of that source's labels (the same entries wallet_label_provenance returns for source='provider_e'), on any chain; it never changes entity, wallet_type or found. Use when the user pastes a CSV of addresses or asks to enrich a list.
name: wallet_batch_labels
title: Wallet Batch Labels
